gate.workload: field-task KK60 adapter with query snapshots and previews, four setup revisions, then 256 distinct gauge/pitch edits
gate.correctness: Keep four setup outcomes and known rejection, accept all edits, reopen paged history; require identical STEP bytes for each edit across variants, independently verify every distinct STEP, validate persisted digests and query old snapshots after reopen.

environment.geometry: Same shipped native executable, source fixture and verification criteria.
environment.measurements: SDK process with local Rust kernel and catalog. Current and peak sampled at edit boundaries before paged audit. Final comparison serialized on CPU 2 in a shared Colima VM. Additional ext4 controls have direct memory.events readback.
environment.excluded_pilot: A preliminary Docker data-volume run was intentionally stopped to avoid filling the shared daemon data disk. Only fresh completed ext4 and virtiofs runs are compared.
environment.intermediate_scope: Exploratory trials used separate cores and could overlap. The final four comparison runs were serialized. The incremental benefit of just the bulk export advice has not been isolated.

validation.runner_runtime: abelien/runner:sandbox-local, Node v22.23.2, SDK + native catalog and CAD; local image with no resident inference agent in this measurement
